description:
Super Gravel Road - Dominate the Road: This Omni Strada Elite XTL disc brake gravel road bike can do it all. It combines powerful disc brakes, a WTB TCS tubeless compatible wheelset, a lightweight aluminum frame and a precision carbon fork.

The frame is built for wide-tire gravel-road use, fits up to about 700x45c, subject to tire-brand fit variation.

Perfect for the entry to sport level athlete who wants the performance of an aluminum frame, the comfort and handling of a carbon fork, and a value price. The compact double FSA crankset helps flatten hills while keeping the drivetrain lighter than many triple-crank builds.

Key features: slick internal cable routing, stealth dropper post routing, Shimano Claris R2000 2x8 drivetrain, Tektro disc brakes, WTB TCS wheels, carbon fork and XTL cross-top brake levers.

components.description: Cartridge sealed bottom bracket with oversized bearings, JIS square, 118mm CrMo spindle x 68mm shell.
Tektro MD-C510 road mechanical disc brakes with flat disc mount and TR160-22 160mm rotors. Brake levers integrated with Shimano ST-R2000 Claris.
KMC Z8.1 narrow chain, 1/2 x 3/32 in. x 110L. 2x8 drivetrain, 16 gears.
FSA Tempo Adventure compact crankset, 46/30T, HG C-Ring black, 170/172.5/175mm for 47-50/53/55-63cm
Shimano Claris FD-R2000 front derailleur for 2x8-speed, band type 34.9mm with 31.8mm adapter
Shimano Claris RD-R2000 GS 8-speed rear derailleur.

700C carbon cross/gravel fork with alloy 1-1/8 in. steerer, 45mm crown, carbon straight blade, flat disc mount, eyelet, 45mm offset and UD weave. Fits most 700x45c tires, subject to tire manufacturer variation.

Alloy road bar with built-in tunnel, 31.8mm clamp, 400/420/440mm by size group, 138mm drop and 100mm reach. 6061 alloy Tioga-OS stem, -6 degree, 70/80/90mm by size group, with FSA No.8 D/DJ 1-1/8 in. integrated 45/45 ACB headset. Motobecane black synthetic EVA cork tape
Road bike pedals with 9/16 in. boron axle

WTB Silverado Comp saddle, 133x280mm, satin steel rail. 6061 alloy seatpost, 27.2mm x 300mm. Aluminum seat clamp with bolt. (insert post min 2 inches below lowest top tube weld / maintain clamp collar tightness)
Shimano Claris ST-R2000 integrated shift/brake levers

Shimano M475L rear freehub, 32H, 8/9/10-speed, 135mm, 6-bolt disc, quick release. 14G black stainless spokes with 14mm brass nipples Choose: Charcoal color model with Maxxis OverDrive MAXX Protect 700x38c tires with reflective sidewalls + puncture protection for $768 OR Red model with WTB Riddler Comp 700x37c tires for $748
WTB ST i19 TCS 700c rims, 32-hole drilling, disc only, black anodized, presta drilled, pinned joint. Shimano M475-L front hub, 32H, 100mm, 6-bolt disc, quick release
